title.zh: 印度数字证书机构eMudhra旗下8个私钥遭破解，浏览器及软件厂商紧急修复
title.en: 印度数字证书机构eMudhra旗下8个私钥遭破解，浏览器及软件厂商紧急修复

current_state.zh: India's eMudhra CA had all 8 of its private keys cracked in under a second because they were weak non-random integers, prompting Chrome, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft to block the certificates and eMudhra to revoke them, with potential knock-on risk for trading bots, exchange API connections and wallet backends that skip revocation checks.
